tagline: Fixes: creatures added mid-combat and heavier modded NPCs.

entries.headline: A bug-fix update: what you place mid-combat joins the turn order without restarting the fight, and modded NPCs can now weigh up to 2 GB.

sections.title: Combat
items: A marker or NPC placed during a fight now joins the turn order on its own, with its own initiative roll. Until now you had to end the fight and start it again.
A participant you remove from the turn order does not come back on its own.
An NPC's initiative modifier now also counts when it joins a fight in progress or when you reroll initiatives.

sections.title: Modded NPCs
items: A modded NPC can now weigh up to 2 GB, instead of 1 GB.
Players see the mods of every NPC the GM was able to publish. Above 512 MB, they saw the NPC's base version, with no message at all.
